title: Vidi speciosam (Lupi)
desc: Johannes Lupi, Vidi speciosam, 1538. 5 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Primus Tenor, Secundus Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0001); edited by Marco Gurrieri, Bonnie Blackburn, Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
